pages.description: Featuring three cute chibi versions of Mommy Long Legs from Poppy Playtime, this close-up illustration highlights curled pigtails, large round eyes, heart tops, and pearl necklaces. Floating hearts and sparkles fill the background of this character coloring page, perfect for smooth shading with gel pens or alcohol markers.

pages.title: Mommy Long Legs Poppy Playtime Free Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Featuring her iconic coiled ponytail hair and signature wide plastic eyes, Mommy Long Legs reaches out with long flexible arms and spidery fingers. Text spelling her name appears in the corner of this detailed outline, which shades amazingly using Procreate or digital art apps on iPad.

pages.title: Playful Mommy Long Legs Magic Wand Wink Sparkle Star Poppy Playtime Free Printable Coloring Pages
pages.description: Unleash magic energy with a cute, stylized full-body line art sheet of Mommy Long Legs winking while holding a magic wand. Outlined with clean, dynamic strokes featuring her iconic curly hair curl, rosy cheek circles, long bendy limbs, and a little floating star accent, this fun character sheet gives kids and fans an awesome canvas for experimenting with vibrant hot pink shades, soft magic glows, and smooth outline coloring.
